entry.question: What happens when only characters (excluding champions) are left in a unit?
entry.ruling:
The unit immediately ceases to exist.

Treat the characters as units on their own and use the lone character rules if applicable.

In combat, any attacks on lower initiative steps may be allocated to those characters according to the rules for multiple units in combat.

Out of combat, the surviving characters and nearby units must make Panic for "nearby friend destroyed" if the US of the destroyed unit was high enough (including the surviving characters). Surviving characters who fail their Panic will Fall Back in Good Order. Any special rules of the unit cease to exist (characters still have their own special rules). If a spell was only on the unit (not being cast by self range by one of the characters), the characters lose the effect of that spell.

entry.question: How would situations resolved where a character without the First Charge rule joins a unit that has it and vice versa?

entry.question: When a character leaves a unit, how is that character affected by any spells or effects that modify the unit's movement? Do they maintain the unit formation they were in, or always move as a skirmisher?
entry.ruling: Movement is checked when a character or unit begins their movement. They move as a skirmisher, and move through other models in their unit freely. Any spells or effects (positive or negative) affect the character's movement during the Remaining Moves phase in which the character leaves the unit. This means that if the unit is affected by Miasmic Mirage, the character cannot march, and if the unit is affected by Steed of Shadows, the character may move using Fly (12). If for any reason the character does not follow the Lone Character rules when not in a unit (such as a character on a light chariot), then they must adhere to the normal movement rules for their respective unit type when leaving the unit.
